name: TableToolbar
label: Table toolbar
description: The control bar over a table: search, filter chips, sort, group, columns, density, saved views and a bulk bar, wired to a DataTable in its toolbar slot.

props.name: columns
props.description: The columns the bar filters and shows, for a bar over some other table. Inside a DataTable's `toolbar` the table's own columns are used.

props.name: filters
props.description: The filters, for controlled use. Inside a DataTable the table's filters are used unless this is set.

props.name: defaultFilters
props.description: Starting filters, for uncontrolled use outside a DataTable.

props.name: onFiltersChange
props.description: Fires with every filter after one is added, changed or removed.

props.name: search
props.description: The search text, for controlled use. Inside a DataTable the table's search is used unless this is set.

props.name: defaultSearch
props.description: Starting search text, for uncontrolled use outside a DataTable.

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Fires with the search text as it changes.

props.name: hiddenColumns
props.description: Hidden column keys, for controlled use. Inside a DataTable the table's are used unless this is set.

props.name: defaultHiddenColumns
props.description: Starting hidden keys, for uncontrolled use outside a DataTable.

props.name: onHiddenColumnsChange
props.description: Fires with every hidden key after the Columns panel changes one.

props.name: size
props.description: The density the bar's controls take and its switch sets, for controlled use. Inside a DataTable the table's density is used unless this is set.

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: Starting density, for uncontrolled use outside a DataTable.

props.name: onSizeChange
props.description: Fires when the density switch changes.

props.name: count
props.description: The result count's numbers, outside a DataTable: rows that match and rows in all.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Shows the search field. Defaults to true.

props.name: filterable
props.description: Shows the Filter button and the filter chips. Defaults to true.

props.name: columnsPanel
props.description: Shows the Columns panel. Defaults to true.

props.name: densitySwitch
props.description: Shows the density switch (in More when the bar folds). Defaults to true.

props.name: showCount
props.description: Shows the result count in the bar. Defaults to true over some other table and false inside a DataTable, whose footer carries the count; set it to move the count into the bar, and the footer leaves it out.

props.name: columnOrder
props.description: Every column key in display order, for controlled use. Inside a DataTable the table's order is used unless this is set.

props.name: defaultColumnOrder
props.description: Starting column order, for uncontrolled use outside a DataTable.

props.name: onColumnOrderChange
props.description: Fires with the full column order after the Columns panel moves one.

props.name: bulkActions
props.description: The actions for the selected rows. Inside a DataTable with `selectable`, selecting a row turns the bar, at the same height, into the bulk bar: Clear, the count, Select all N, then these, the first non-destructive one and the first destructive one labelled and the rest in a More menu.

props.name: sorts
props.description: Every sort, first sort first, for controlled use. Inside a DataTable the table's sorts are used unless this is set.

props.name: defaultSorts
props.description: Initial sorts for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onSortsChange
props.description: Fires with every sort after the sort panel changes one.

props.name: views
props.description:
Saved views, shown as tabs over the bar inside a DataTable: picking one
applies its setup to the table, its tab shows a dot while the table no
longer matches it, and its menu saves, saves as new, resets, renames
and deletes. For controlled use; store them however you like (each
`view` is plain data). Pair with `onViewsChange`.

props.name: defaultViews
props.description: The saved views to start with, for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onViewsChange
props.description: Fires with every view after one is saved, added, renamed or deleted.

props.name: activeView
props.description: The active view's id, for controlled use. Pair with `onActiveViewChange`.

props.name: defaultActiveView
props.description: The view active to begin with, for uncontrolled use. Defaults to the first.

props.name: onActiveViewChange
props.description: Fires with the id of the view picked or added.

props.name: grouping
props.description: The column keys the rows are grouped by, for controlled use. Inside a DataTable the table's grouping is used unless this is set.

props.name: defaultGrouping
props.description: The grouping to start with, for uncontrolled use.

props.name: onGroupingChange
props.description: Fires with the new grouping when the Group panel changes it.

props.name: groupable
props.description: Shows the Group button, whose panel picks the column the rows group by. Defaults to true; it shows when a column is `groupable`.

props.name: sortable
props.description: Shows the Sort button, whose panel orders, flips and removes the sorts. Defaults to true; inside a DataTable it shows when a column sorts, and holds one sort unless the table has `multiSort`.

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: The page's main action (New project, Invite), drawn as the primary button at the bar's end.

props.name: secondaryActions
props.description: Actions beside the primary one (Export, Import), drawn as icon buttons before it, each named and tooltipped by its label; folded, they move into the More panel.

props.name: actions
props.description: Any other controls at the bar's end, after the actions.

props.name: command
props.description:
The AI command: a button at the bar's start that turns the whole row into a
one-off composer, as selecting rows turns it into the bulk bar, whose
text your handler turns into a whole table setup. It reaches everything a
view holds (filters, sorts, search, columns, pinning, grouping, density),
so it can do in a sentence what the bar's other controls do one at a time.
A long request grows the composer to three rows, pushing the table down.
The library calls no model; your handler does. A change or an error lands in
a toast, in the surrounding ToastProvider's stack if there is one, else in the
bar's own at the bottom-right. Shows only inside a DataTable.

props.name: labels
props.description: The bar's words, merged over their English defaults.

props.name: filterLabels
props.description: The filters' words, merged over their English defaults (inside a DataTable, over the table's).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes
